title: Cardo Spirit HD Duo
features: Bluetooth hands-free calling with noise cancellation
HD audio quality for crystal clear communication
Intercom capability for up to 10 riders
description:
Engineered to seamlessly integrate into modern helmet speaker cavities, the Cardo Spirit HD Duo from Cardo provides riders with uninterrupted acoustic clarity and group connectivity. Built with IP67 Certified Dustproof & Submersion Resistant (All-Season Waterproof Seal), it boasts an installation rating of 2.5 / 10 (Clamp-mount or 3M VHB base with recessed speaker cavity routing).

The Cardo Spirit HD Duo represents an indispensable touring and group-ride upgrade from Cardo. Its robust audio tuning and rock-solid weather sealing provide riders with effortless navigation cues and reliable connectivity across arduous highway tours.
